findings.source_quote: "Well," Big David began to brag, "With my longer legs, and freshly sprayed WD40, my bike is sure to be the fastest."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate "freshly sprayed WD40" more idiomatically and accurately. Replace "nymontert WD40" with "nysprayet WD40" or "ferskt sprayet WD40" so the sentence reads: "«Vel,» begynte Store David og skryte, «med mine lengre ben, og ferskt sprayet WD40, er sykkelen min helt sikkert den raskeste.»" Preserve HTML structure.
